author: Inside Edition
description: Two pickup trucks slammed into each other and crashed into a police cruiser in a dramatic chain reaction. As the vehicles collided, a 7-year-old boy was ejected from the rear window of the Ford F-150, flying onto the hood of the cop car in Georgia. Police officer Arianna James rushed to the boy's aid.  The shaken up youngster is in good condition, but cops say he was not wearing a seatbelt at the time of the crash.
title: 7-Year-Old Ejected From Car And Onto Police Cruiser After Collision

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman suffered severe burns on her face, she says, from a facial. Victoria Nelson says she has been a client of Beverly Hills celebrity esthetician Sonya Dakar for years. Nelson developed white spots that she says marked where solution was dropped on her face. Nelson says she went back to Dakar to fix her burns over the next two years. She eventually went to a dermatologist who told her she suffered from a severe chemical burn. Dakar, who denies any wrongdoing, did not respond to Inside Edition's request for comment.
title: Woman Says She Suffered Severe Burns After Facial From Celebrity Esthetician

author: Inside Edition
description: In a new undercover investigation, PETA, the animal rights group, alleges they recorded serious animal cruelty violations taking place at what PETA calls a parakeet mill. Hidden camera footage taken by PETA and shared exclusively with INSIDE EDITION allegedly shows thousands of parakeets packed into crowded cages at Creekside Birds, a parakeet breeding facility in rural Oklahoma. PETA investigators claim sick and dying birds were denied proper veterinary care. PETA also says their undercover investigator recorded some Creekside workers describing how they would kill birds deemed too ill to sell. PETA alleges that some birds bred there are shipped through a nationwide so-called "parakeet pipeline" that supplies birds to some pet stores across the country. Creekside Birds did not respond to repeated requests for comment.
title: Exclusive: PETA Undercover Investigation Exposes Alleged Animal Abuse At So-Called Parakeet Mill

author: Inside Edition
description: Graphic novelist and filmmaker Marjane Satrapi has died. Satrapi earned acclaim for her best-selling graphic memoirs, "Persepolis." The passing of the Oscar-nominated French-Iranian artist was announced in a statement issued by close friends and family. It said in part, "Marjane Satrapi died of sadness a little over a year after the death of Mattias Ripa, her husband and the love of her life." Marjane Satrapi was 56 years old.
title: Oscar-Nominated Marjane Satrapi Dies 'From Sadness' At 56

author: Inside Edition
description: A family of geese found themselves in peril Tuesday in Aberdeen Maryland when they were stranded on I-95 and it was all caught on camera. Thanks to an Aberdeen police officer and good Samaritans the family of geese were able to get to safety. Luckily, no geese were harmed crossing the busy highway.
title: Good Samaritans Help Flock of Geese Cross Busy Highway

author: Inside Edition
description: Little Amiah got her ears pierced for her fourth birthday. A few weeks later, the 4-year-old swallowed one of the earrings.
title: Little Girl Swallows Earring #shorts
